content:
Hi Pasquale Riccio

The kind members trying to assist you hadn't realised your query relates to Thunderbird for Android (v21), not the desktop PC version.

A) There's no repair folder tool in the mobile app.

Lets start fresh !

The recently released v21 introduced a bug, as you've discovered, which broke the ability to empty the trash and spam folders. Sorry it's not better news. Unfortunately bugs occationally slip through.

Developers have already applied a fix in the code, which will be included in v23's stable release. You can find more detail in the bug report here and code fix here.

There's no setting you can change that will fix this.

What now

  • You may find it sufficient to use your webmail or another existing client to empty the folders while awaiting the fix.
  • If your accounts all use imap and your technically minded, the below may interest you as an interim measure allowing you to empty spam and trash folders from your mobile.

Install K9-Mail v20.1 (along side Thunderbird v21).

K9-Mail if your unfamiliar, is built from the same code base by the same team as Thunderbird Android. It's near identical with the same features, layout, and versions. It will be immediately familiar. The only difference is a red theme vs Thunderbirds blue one.

1. Download K9-Mail v20.1 from the F-Droid store. Google play only has the later version of K9, which has the same bug.

2. Export your account configuration from Thunderbird to K9 to save some setup time.

Hope this is of some help. Feel free to reach out if you have further questions.
